description: Return the published Ed25519 signer key set Intentrax proofs are checked against (production: trust-bearing, min_trusted_signers applies; sandbox: never trust-bearing), with its SHA-256, so the user can verify a proof offline with `npx @intentrax/sdk verify-proof --trusted-keys`. Read-only; no network call.

environment.description: Which published key set to return.

name: intentrax_get_trusted_key_set
title: Get Intentrax's published signer keys
